title: Night Credit After a Prescribed Pressure Change — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Night Credit After a Prescribed Pressure Change — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Clinical note.** A pressure change re-starts acclimation, and a PAP Therapy Equipment usage summary credits nights for it:

- a record with an **approved** pressure change request is credited **3 nights**;
- a record whose pressure change request is **still submitted** is credited **1 night**;
- any other record is credited none.

**Where it is read.** From the requests on the device record whose type is a pressure change, by their status. An approved request decides the credit whenever one is on the record, whatever other pressure change requests show.

| Pressure change requests on the record | Nights credited |
|---|---|
| at least one approved | 3 |
| none approved, at least one submitted | 1 |
| none approved and none submitted (or no such request) | 0 |

**Cases (hypothetical).** A request approved last month and a newer one still submitted: 3 nights. A single request still submitted: 1 night.
